title: 11. Projects: Memory & Context Engineering in AI Agents
summary: Projects for Memory & Context Engineering in AI Agents.
objectives: Build the Memory & Context Engineering in AI Agents projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
memory_agents/
│
├── core/
│   ├── memory/
│   │   ├── working_memory.py      ← In-context window manager
│   │   ├── short_term_memory.py   ← Session/Redis memory
│   │   ├── long_term_memory.py    ← Vector + SQL persistence
│   │   ├── episodic_memory.py     ← Event log memory
│   │   ├── semantic_memory.py     ← Knowledge/RAG memory
│   │   └── memory_manager.py      ← Unified memory controller
│   │
│   └── context/
│       ├── context_builder.py     ← Assembles context window
│       ├── context_compressor.py  ← Summarizes/compresses
│       ├── context_router.py      ← Decides what to include
│       └── context_optimizer.py   ← Token budget optimizer
│
├── agents/
│   ├── memory_agent_base.py       ← Base agent with all memory
│   ├── langchain_memory_agent.py  ← LangChain implementation
│   ├── langgraph_memory_agent.py  ← LangGraph implementation
│   ├── pydantic_memory_agent.py   ← PydanticAI implementation
│   └── sk_memory_agent.py         ← Semantic Kernel implementation
│
├── scenarios/
│   ├── 01_short_term.py           ← Session memory demo
│   ├── 02_long_term.py            ← Persistent memory demo
│   ├── 03_episodic.py             ← Event/history demo
│   ├── 04_semantic.py             ← Knowledge retrieval demo
│   └── 05_full_memory_agent.py    ← All memory types together
│
└── main.py
```
